notes: Success delivery callbacks were added after each campaign send route. Set the website URL and WhatsApp automation secret on callback modules before enabling.
Replace placeholder WAHA API credentials and session name. Do not paste credentials into shared files.

For WAHA send errors, add Make error handlers to sendText/sendImage/sendVideo. Each handler should POST to /api/whatsapp-broadcast/automation/delivery-result with recipientId={{4.data.recipientId}}, campaignId={{4.data.campaignId}}, status=failed, and an error message, using x-whatsapp-automation-secret.
The callback means WAHA accepted the send request. Forward WAHA message.ack events to the website for delivered/read updates.
